entries.jp: アナウンス
entries.en: Announcer

entries.jp: 予選開始
entries.en: Preliminary Round Begins

entries.jp: {v:0008}もぉ～～！{n}ドジなんだからぁ！
entries.en: {v:0008}Ughhh! You're such a klutz!

entries.jp: {v:0055}ああっ！ルイセちゃんが！{n}もぅっ！敵討ちよ！
entries.en: {v:0055}Oh, no! Luise-chan! Grrr! I'll get them for this!

entries.jp: １匹倒したけど、{n}予選突破は無理だね‥‥。
entries.en: We got one, but we can't make it through the{n}preliminaries now...

entries.jp: よ～し、これで１匹！
entries.en: All right! That's one down!

entries.jp: ２匹倒せたけど、{n}予選突破は無理だね‥‥。
entries.en: We got two, but we can't make it through the{n}preliminaries now...

entries.jp: ２匹目ゲット！{n}この調子でどんどん行こう！
entries.en: That's number two! Keep it up!

entries.jp: やったね★{n}これで３匹目。{n}もう予選突破できたも同然だね！
entries.en: We did it! That's number three! We've practically made{n}it through the preliminaries!

entries.jp: すご～い！{n}アタシ達だけで、４匹も倒したよ！
entries.en: Wooow! We took down four all by ourselves!

entries.jp: ありゃりゃ？{n}全部、アタシ達だけで倒しちゃったね★
entries.en: Well, whaddaya know? We took them ALL{n}down ourselves!

entries.jp: あぁ！{n}１匹、倒されちゃったよ！
entries.en: Ah! Someone else got one!

entries.jp: あ～あ。{n}２匹目も倒されちゃった。
entries.en: Aww... Someone else got the second one, too.

entries.jp: アンタ、もうちょっとがんばりなさいよ！
entries.en: Hey, you! Try a little harder!

entries.jp: よ、４匹目‥‥。{n}ダ、ダメだわ、これは‥‥。
entries.en: Th-the fourth one... Th-this isn't looking good...

entries.jp: く～っ！{n}１匹も倒せないなんて、アンタ、何やってるのよ！
entries.en: Grrr! You couldn't even take down ONE?! What are{n}you doing?!

entries.jp: おおっ～と！{n}２組のグループがゲルを２匹ずつ倒しています！{n}つまりこの勝負は引き分け！{p}しかし予選を抜けられるグループは１組のみ。{n}この２組には、さらに勝負をしてもらいましょう！{p}まず、負けたグループは退場して下さい！
entries.en: Ohhh! Two teams have defeated two Gels each! That{n}means we have a tie!{p}But only one team can advance past the preliminaries.{n}These two teams will have to face off again!{p}First, the losing teams must leave the arena!

entries.jp: さぁ、この２組に勝敗を付けてもらいましょう！{n}勝負は簡単。{p}１匹だけ出るゲルを、どちらが早く倒すか？{n}ゲルが出る場所は会場中央！{n}みなさん、ご注目下さい！
entries.en: Now, let's have these two teams settle this! The rules{n}are simple.{p}Who can defeat a single Gel first? The Gel will appear in{n}the center of the arena! All eyes on the{n}center, everyone!

entries.jp: ゲルが現れました！{n}さぁ、目が離せない展開になってきました！{n}試合、再開です！
entries.en: The Gel has appeared! You won't want to take your{n}eyes off this! The match resumes!

entries.jp: 悔し～！{n}負けちゃったよ～！
entries.en: No faaair! We looost!
